name: TARGET_TASK_ASMTS
description: This table stores the patient encounters and assessments for target progress assessments.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the task record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: TARGET_PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: This item stores the patient CSNs of the target assessments.

columns.name: TARGET_OVERALL_ASMT_C_NAME
columns.description: This item stores the overall assessments of the target assessments.

columns.name: TARGET_PROG_ASMT_C_NAME
columns.description: This item stores the progression assessments of the target assessments.

columns.name: TARGET_ASSESSED_INST_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: This item stores the instants that the user most recently assessed the target over different encounters.

columns.name: TARGET_ASSESSED_USER_ID
columns.description: This item stores the users that most recently assessed the target over different encounters.

columns.name: TARGET_ASSESSED_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.
